context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart Composite Explorer Fallback fully implemented and tested. Frontend now queries public blockchain explorers (mempool.space, blockstream.info, blockcypher, litecoinspace.org, mazacha.in) directly instead of routing through backend proxy. chainExplorer.js handles automatic fallback between multiple explorer sources with circuit breaker protection (3 failures = 60s cooldown).
